Messages from Classmates
Graduation day has finally arrived. But so many never made it back.
If I hadn't slipped away early that day... could I have done something for them? When I look at the empty seats in our classroom, I often feel guilty for being powerless. Fulwish, did you feel the same?
But I've come to terms with it now. The past is the past. Those of us left behind... we have to take care of ourselves.
I hear the climate on Garden Star of Botanical Study is very different. Take care of yourself, Fulwish.
 — Sia

Winning first place in the campus imagenesis competition, ranking at the top for several consecutive semesters... You have always been outstanding, Fulwish.
That's why I truly believe you can make it through that nightmare and show all of Planarcadia, with a smile, that we won't be easily defeated by a single tragedy. I've never doubted that.
A new chapter in life is about to begin. Facing the lens of life, please keep on smiling!

 — Sara

Message from a Teacher
Hearing that you will soon leave Planarcadia to pursue cognitive science, I can't help but feel a sense of loss. It's a failure on my part as a teacher that I couldn't inspire you to stay in the imagenesis industry.
But as your teacher, I fully understand your choice. To have helped shape a researcher like you for the Intelligentsia Guild fills me with deep pride.
I sincerely wish you the vastest of horizons, Fulwish. May you realize your dreams, and may the sorrow sown in the past blossom into flowers of happiness in the future.

 — Hermien
